labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory (pygments/requests CVEs from pip-audit output), not a Rich defect

items.body:
The pip-audit output in this report lists advisories for third-party packages (`pygments` and `requests`), not for Rich's own code, so this is labelled as an upstream dependency issue. Rich depends on Pygments; the maintainers track dependency updates there.

For private reports of security vulnerabilities in Rich itself, see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
